18169.name: Wabash County
18169.note: Wabash County is served by two ambulance services. The City of Wabash Fire Department provides ambulance and rescue service to most of the county under a five-year county contract approved in December 2023. Parkview Health provides ambulance service to the two townships around North Manchester under a separate county agreement.
a: Wabash Fire Department EMS (City of Wabash)
